snippet.title: KROMEX — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Kromex — Tactical Spell Combat on a Hex Grid
Free-to-play Early Access — June 5, 2026

▶️ WISHLIST & PLAY ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615870/Kromex/

💬 JOIN THE DISCORD:
https://discord.com/invite/w3kjy6aqW6

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇬🇧 ABOUT KROMEX

Kromex is a tactical spell-combat game on a hexagonal battlefield, 
built by Tom & Pakam — a 2-person French indie studio based in 
Strasbourg (Fuki-Studio).

Pick your faction among 8 colors, cast 7 hand-crafted spells 
(Bump, Wave, Punch, Bomb, Mine, Turret, Dash) and dominate the 
board through positioning, combos and territory control.

✦ 1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3 / 4v4 — classic team formats
✦ 2v2v2v2 — four-team chaos using all 8 faction colors
✦ FFA up to 8 players — every wizard for themselves
✦ Solo vs bots (1–7 AI) + spectator mode + tutorial
✦ 10 supported languages
✦ Free-to-play, anti-pay-to-win — optional Support Pack DLC 
  unlocks cosmetics only (no gameplay impact, ever)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇫🇷 À PROPOS DE KROMEX

Kromex est un jeu de combat de sorts tactique sur grille hexagonale, 
fait par Tom & Pakam — un studio indé français à 2 personnes basé 
à Strasbourg (Fuki-Studio).

Choisis ta faction parmi 8 couleurs, lance 7 sorts faits main 
(Bump, Wave, Punch, Bomb, Mine, Tourelle, Dash) et domine le 
plateau grâce au placement, aux combos et au contrôle de territoire.

✦ 1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3 / 4v4 — formats classiques en équipe
✦ 2v2v2v2 — chaos à 4 équipes exploitant les 8 couleurs
✦ FFA jusqu'à 8 joueurs — chacun pour soi
✦ Mode solo contre bots (1 à 7 IA) + spectateur + tutoriel
✦ 10 langues supportées
✦ Free-to-play, anti-pay-to-win — DLC Pack Soutien optionnel 
  uniquement cosmétique (aucun impact gameplay, jamais)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📅 RELEASE: June 5, 2026 — Steam Early Access (free-to-play)
🎮 STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615870/Kromex/
💬 DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/w3kjy6aqW6
📧 CONTACT: FukiStudioSupport@proton.me

#Multiplayer #FrenchIndieDev #FukiStudio #SteamGames #EarlyAccess
